help_body:
1. Select a building and assign crew.
2. Advance the day to produce resources.
3. Everyone uses 3 water and 3 food daily.
4. Water, farming and research need electricity.
5. Prepare for dust storms and solar flares.

Survive 15 days and gather 30 research to win.
A resource below zero or zero health ends the mission.
Reassign freely. Progress saves after each day.
sources_body:
Solar flares: NASA SDO observed an X8.7 flare
on May 14, 2024. This historical observation
inspired our warnings. It is NOT live weather.

Communications: Mars has a roughly 4–24 minute
one-way light delay. Here, resupply answers arrive
after 2 game days to make waiting tangible.
This is NOT the real signal or shipping time.

Resource units, production and health effects are
provisional game balance, not NASA measurements.
